description: Dashboard architecture patterns for the AIOS command center (Layer 7)

patterns.name: Notion Workspace
patterns.description: Use Notion as the AIOS dashboard — databases for tracking, pages for documentation, views for different roles

recommended_views.name: Operations Hub
recommended_views.shows: Active automations, recent AI actions, pending reviews, alerts

recommended_views.name: Skill Library
recommended_views.shows: All custom skills with usage stats, last run, status

recommended_views.name: Client Dashboard
recommended_views.shows: Per-client overview: recent interactions, open items, context health

recommended_views.name: AIOS Health
recommended_views.shows: Layer scores, connection status, data freshness, error rates

patterns.mcp_integration: Connect via Notion MCP server for automated page updates

patterns.name: Claude Code Project
patterns.description: Use Claude Code project structure as the dashboard — CLAUDE.md as config, memory files as state, skills as actions
cons: No shared team views without git

recommended_views.name: CLAUDE.md
recommended_views.shows: Business rules, quick links, system status summary

recommended_views.name: memory/ directory
recommended_views.shows: Client files, project state, operational context

recommended_views.name: skills/ directory
recommended_views.shows: Available skills with descriptions and usage

recommended_views.name: /status skill
recommended_views.shows: Custom skill that queries all connected tools and reports system health

patterns.mcp_integration: Native — Claude Code IS the integration layer

patterns.name: Custom Web Application
patterns.description: Build a dedicated web dashboard — full control over data visualization, real-time updates, team access
cons: Requires developer or Claude Code proficiency

recommended_views.name: Executive Dashboard
recommended_views.shows: KPIs, revenue metrics, AIOS health score, alerts

recommended_views.name: Operations Center
recommended_views.shows: Active automations, queued tasks, error logs, data flows

recommended_views.name: Client Portal
recommended_views.shows: Per-client view with project status, deliverables, communications

recommended_views.name: AI Activity Log
recommended_views.shows: What AI has done, decisions made, items pending human review

patterns.mcp_integration: Custom API endpoints that MCP servers and Claude Code skills can query/update

recommendation_logic.description: How to recommend a dashboard pattern based on client profile

rules.rationale: Lowest barrier to entry, no coding required
Natural extension of existing Claude Code usage
Needs role-based access and real-time data at scale
